## What changed and why?

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link a related issue if there is one.

## Validation

List the checks you actually ran and their results. For documentation-only changes, checking instructions and links can be sufficient; mark code tests as not run rather than claiming they passed.

For converter changes, describe the synthetic regression case and the expected Markdown, raw-source, and report behavior.

## Review notes

Mention compatibility changes, limitations, or decisions that need reviewer attention. Remove this section if there are none.

## Before submitting

- [ ] The changes and examples contain no real exports, private conversation contents, credentials, or account identifiers.
- [ ] Relevant instructions and format documentation reflect the change, or this is not applicable.
- [ ] If conversion behavior changed, I considered source-byte preservation, unknown fields, output-path safety, and a meaningful synthetic regression test; otherwise this is not applicable.
